act.name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
act.source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
act.description: An Act to provide protection against sexual harassment of women at workplace and for the prevention and redressal of complaints of sexual harassment.

sections.title: Constitution of Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
sections.text: (1) Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the 'Internal Complaints Committee': Provided that where the offices or administrative units of the workplace are located at different places, the Internal Committee shall be constituted at all administrative units or offices.
sections.plain_language_summary: Every organization with 10 or more employees must set up an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to investigate complaints of sexual harassment.
sections.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

sections.title: Complaint of sexual harassment
sections.text: (1) Any aggrieved woman may make, in writing, a complaint of sexual harassment at workplace to the Internal Committee if so constituted, or the Local Committee, in case it is not so constituted, within a period of three months from the date of incident.
sections.plain_language_summary: An aggrieved woman can file a written harassment complaint with the ICC or Local Committee within 3 months of the incident.
sections.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
